title: Repeated loss of DCX in cypriniform fishes: data and code
description:
Scripts, results and supplementary tables for the article Cypriniform fishes lost doublecortin repeatedly despite strong purifying selection on the gene (Alemán-Gutiérrez, submitted).

The repository documents a family census with verified orthology, raw-read tests of gene absence, a read-based census of 243 cypriniform specimens, microsynteny, a genome compaction control, selective constraint analyses, the DC-only isoform of dclk1a and its expression, and the dating of DCX losses on a time-calibrated phylogeny. All input data are public.
